name: Fall Coffee Lineup
description:
Fall showed up. We brought backup.
 
The Fall Coffee Lineup packs four ground coffees into one box, covering everything from classic seasonal flavors to one seriously unhinged llama. Pumpkin Spice handles the fall tradition, Bourbon brings smooth vanilla and caramel, Maple Pecan goes rich and nutty, and limited-edition Atomic Llama rolls in with cinnamon, brown sugar, and nutmeg.
 
Consider your fall coffee rotation officially loaded.
 
What’s Included

Bourbon Ground Coffee, 11oz
Pumpkin Spice Ground Coffee, 12oz
Maple Pecan Ground Coffee, 11oz
Atomic Llama Ground Coffee, 11oz

name: Tactisquatch Roast
description: The lore of the fabled Tactisquatch has grown stronger every day. Legend has it that this Honduran Arabica dark roast offers tasting notes of black currant, molasses, and orange. While the public only has rumors to fill their imagination, you have proof that this mythical creature is alive, well, and only a click away.

name: Pumpkin Spice Roast
description: Pumpkin spice season doesn't need another soft launch. BRCC's Limited Edition Pumpkin Spice Roast takes a medium roast base and loads it with real pumpkin spice flavor, warm cinnamon, nutmeg, and just enough sweetness to make your kitchen smell like a win.Grind it yourself or let the Keurig® do the work, this roast shows up either way. The 12oz Ground bag is for the ones who still brew it the old fashioned way. The 22-Count K-Cups® are for the ones who want the flavor without the extra steps. Same roast, same flavor, your call on format.Every bag and every box supports a company built by veterans, for people who don't do things halfway. This one's Limited Edition, meaning it's not sticking around past the season. Pick your format and grab it while it's here.

name: Just Black Roast - Limited RWB Edition
description:
The coffee that started it all now wrapped in a Limited Edition Red, White & Blue bag for Military Appreciation Month. There's dark, light, and there's just right. Our flagship medium roast strikes the perfect balance between bold and smooth; built to be the best cup of drip coffee you'll ever taste.
Just Black delivers an aroma of cocoa and vanilla, bold, balanced flavor, and finishes with a smooth, buttery finish that keeps you coming back for more.
Available in Ground only. Stock up while the Limited Edition RWB bags last.

name: Just Decaf
description:
Just Decaf... thats it. Some things are better kept simple.
This 100% Colombian medium coffee gives you delicious cocoa, vanilla, and buttery-tasting notes - without the caffeine.
We use the Swiss Water process to decaffeinate the beans. It's a more time-consuming process, but using only water to wash and rewash the caffeine out of the coffee beans helps keep every cup of yours clean and of high quality. Chemical shortcuts are harsh on the beans, so the extra time spent washing is fine by us. Whatever it takes to get you the best decaf coffee on the market.
*Trace amounts of caffeine will remain due to the natural process used.

name: Freedom Roast
description: If our Founding Fathers were to make their own smooth medium-bodied roast with tasting notes of milk chocolate and vanilla, hints of cinnamon and a buttery finish, and liberation! It's America's Coffee.

name: Thirty Presents Out
description:
Santa’s getting an early start. Your coffee stash should, too. Thirty Presents Out is back ahead of the holiday rush, bringing bold flavor with notes of chocolate, smoke, and fruit in a smooth, rich dark roast. Available in Ground, Whole Bean, and K-Cups®, it’s ready for your morning brew now—and the packed house, full plates, and questionable family conversations still to come.
 
Get a head start on your gift list, stock your own supply, and make sure good coffee is handled before the holiday chaos kicks in. Thirty Presents Out is only here for a limited time. Grab yours early.

name: Dark Roast Bundle
description:
Three of Black Rifle Coffee Company's boldest dark roasts, one legendary bundle.
 
The Dark Roast Bundle brings together Beyond Black, Tactisquatch, and Blackbeard's Delight in one convenient package for those who prefer rich, full-bodied coffee with uncompromising flavor.
 
Choose the format that fits your routine:


Ground Bundle includes one 12 oz bag each of Beyond Black, Tactisquatch, and Blackbeard's Delight.

Whole Bean Bundle includes one 12 oz whole bean bag each of Beyond Black, Tactisquatch, and Blackbeard's Delight.

K-Cup Bundle includes one 12-count box each of Beyond Black, Tactisquatch, and Blackbeard's Delight.

 
Whether you're stocking up for the week or discovering your next favorite roast, this bundle delivers bold flavor from sunrise to lights out.
 
Bundle Includes

1 x Beyond Black
1 x Tactisquatch
1 x Blackbeard's Delight

 
Available in:

Ground
Whole Bean
K-Cup Pods

name: Beyond Black Roast
description: The color black brings to mind thoughts of power, elegance, formality, death, evil, and mystery. As a color, it is both frightening yet undeniably compelling. Our core dark roast, Beyond Black, has long explored our innate curiosity for all things unknown, and our new design brings that sentiment to the forefront.Enjoy this new look for a timeless BRCC classic and revel in its powerful spicy aromas, notes of dark chocolate, and sublime smoky finish.

name: Coffee Saves Roast
description:
Coffee solves most problems. Long night? Easy fix. A little backed up? We got that handled too. This smooth medium roast features notes of citrus, and a sweet aroma all tied up with a clean finish.
Black Rifle prescribes Coffee Saves for those suffering from caffeine deficiency, and we strongly recommend you get the rest of your medical advice from actual professionals. Use our Donation Request Form and one of our donation specialists will help you give back to those who serve your community every day. No extra charge to you. We cover every penny.

name: Atomic Llama
description:
THE LLAMA IS BACK. THIS IS NOT A DRILL.
 
Some coffees quietly return to the lineup. Atomic Llama kicks the door off the hinges and makes sure you know it’s here.
 
Back for a limited time, this fan-favorite medium roast brings together cinnamon and brown sugar for a warm, sweet cup with plenty of character. It’s smooth, bold, and built for mornings that need a little more firepower. And yes, there’s still a nuclear-powered llama on the bag. Because some legends are better left unexplained.
 
If you’ve been waiting for Atomic Llama to make a comeback, this is your shot. And if it’s your first time, consider this your introduction to one of the wildest coffees we’ve ever put in a bag.
 
Atomic Llama is only back for a limited run, so grab it while the herd’s still loose.

name: Happy Hunting Roast
description:
Meet your hunting season dark roast. Happy Hunting delivers a rich, bold cup with notes of dark chocolate, walnut, and maple. Deep chocolate notes lead the way, followed by a nutty balance and a touch of maple sweetness—built for that first pour before daylight and worth coming back to for a refill.
 
Available in a 12oz ground bag, it’s ready for the drip pot at home or your coffee setup at camp. Brew a pot before heading out, fill your thermos, and give those early mornings something worth waking up for. This is the roast to keep within reach all hunting season, wherever you’re pouring.
















Happy Hunting is only here for a limited time. Grab a bag before your next trip—the first cup at camp deserves the good stuff.

name: Happy Hunting Kit
description:
The best part of hunting season starts long before anybody fills a tag. It’s the truck packed the night before. The first cup in a cold camp. Your buddies around the fire, making big plans for opening morning. The Happy Hunting Kit belongs in the middle of all of it, bringing your camp coffee essentials together with gear that keeps hunting season going long after the weekend ends.
 
Pack it for yourself or give it to your favorite hunting buddy. A filled tag is never guaranteed. Good coffee should be.
 
WHAT'S INCLUDED:

Limited Edition Happy Hunting Ground Coffee, 12oz bag
Bugles & Black Coffee T-Shirt
America's Coffee RWB Enamel Mug, 17oz
Aeropress Coffee Maker

Aeropress Coffee Maker Filters

name: Happy Hunting Fully Loaded Kit
description:
The Happy Hunting Fully Loaded Kit is built for mornings you wouldn’t trade for an extra hour of sleep. A fresh brew on the tailgate. Cold air and camo zipped up to your chin. Your buddies gathered around, pouring another cup and talking through the day’s hunt. Happy Hunting brings the coffee, YETI brings the serious hardware, and the camo earns its place every time the temperature drops.
 
This is the setup you’ll be packing long after this season’s tags are filled. Go all in for yourself or give your favorite hunting buddy something they’ll still be thanking you for next opening morning. Good seasons become stories. Good gear gets invited back.
 
WHAT’S INCLUDED:

Limited Edition Happy Hunting Ground Coffee, 12oz bag
BRCC x YETI Company Logo French Press 
YETI Company Logo Rambler Tumbler, 30oz

Company Logo Trucker Hat, Mossy Oak Country

Grenade Waffle Fleece Quarter Zip Pullover — your choice of available color and size

name: Shooting Time, 12oz, Ground
description:
When It's Shootin' Time, Be Ready.
 
Introducing Shootin' Time Roast, the official coffee collaboration between Black Rifle Coffee Company and Riley Green.
 
Built for early mornings and long days, this smooth, balanced medium roast delivers dependable flavor for whatever's ahead. Inspired by Riley Green's grit and hard-working roots, it's made for the hunters, outdoorsmen, tradesmen, and anyone who knows success is earned.
 
Get up early. Stay ready. Make your shot.

name: RCKR Roast, 12oz, Ground
description:
Ride for Glory. Brew for the Long Haul.
 
Introducing RCKR Roast, the official coffee collaboration between Black Rifle Coffee Company and professional rodeo athlete Rocker Steiner.

Built for early mornings, long days, and those who refuse to stay in the chute, RCKR Roast is a light roast ground coffee crafted to fuel relentless ambition. Featuring a delicate floral aroma and notes of orange, caramel, and biscotti, this smooth, approachable roast delivers a bright and balanced cup that keeps you charging toward the next ride.
 
Rocker Steiner represents a new generation of grit, determination, and western heritage‚Äîand this coffee embodies that same spirit. Whether you're heading to the ranch, the arena, the jobsite, or simply chasing your own version of greatness, RCKR Roast is made for those who bet on themselves every day.

From the first light of dawn to the final buzzer, RCKR Roast is built for those who put in the work, embrace the challenge, and never stop pushing forward.

Saddle up. Stay hungry. Keep charging.




Tasting Notes

Biscotti
Caramel
Orange







Roast Profile

Roast: Light
Type: Ground Coffee
Size: 12 oz.

name: Just Black Roast
description:
The coffee that started it all. There's dark, light, and there's just right. Our flagship coffee strikes the perfect balance between the bold and the smooth. Our best medium roast was developed to be the best drip coffee you'll ever taste!
Just Black features an aroma thats a mixture of cocoa and vanilla, bold tasting notes, and brings it all home with a smooth buttery finish.

name: Bourbon Roast
description:
Want a little snakebite with your coffee? Take one sip of this smokey Bourbon-flavored coffee and it'll transport you to a whiskey still somewhere in the Smoky Mountains.

Bourbon tasting notes: Vanilla, floral notes, caramel, and bourbon flavor
Easy to store, keep fresh quick and convenient way to enjoy America's coffee

name: Dictator Geisha Roast
description:
Dictator Geisha, Limited Edition Guatemala Geisha (12oz Whole Bean)
Our most exclusive drop is back, and this lot is a whole new beast. Grown at 1,800 meters in Pueblo Nuevo Viñas, Santa Rosa, Guatemala, this Geisha varietal is washed processed for a clean, elegant cup with a floral aroma and a silky body that punches way above its weight.
Floral? Yes. Soft? Not even a little.
Scoring 89 on the cupping table, Dictator Geisha is a rare, small lot coffee roasted for Coffeeheads who chase the extraordinary and don't settle for ordinary.
Limited edition: once it's gone, it's gone. Elevate your brew ritual with the crown jewel of BRCC.

name: Salty Caramel Roast
description:
BRCC's Salty Caramel coffee grounds features hints of caramel and vanilla tasting notes for a full-bodied flavor you can enjoy during a busy morning or for a midday boost. Each cup you brew will fill your kitchen with a satisfying aroma, and the taste is so silky smooth you'll forget your creamer.
If you're looking for the world's best coffee, get it from members of the world's finest military; A portion of our proceeds go to directly support the causes that help veterans and first responders.

name: Indulgent Flavored Coffee Bundle
description:
Sometimes you don't want subtle. You want flavor.
 
The Indulgent Flavored Coffee Bundle brings together two of our richest flavored coffees: Salty Caramel and Dark Chocolate. One delivers smooth caramel sweetness with a hint of salt, while the other layers bold coffee with deep chocolate notes. Whether you're starting your morning or reaching for an afternoon refill, this duo keeps every cup anything but ordinary.
 
Veteran founded and small batch roasted, both coffees are crafted to deliver full-bodied flavor without sacrificing the quality of the roast. Choose the format that fits your routine and enjoy two fan-favorite flavors in one bundle.
 
What's Inside:

Salty Caramel Roast
Dark Chocolate Roast

 
Available in 11oz Ground Coffee and 12 Count K-Cups.

name: AK-Espresso Roast
description: This indestructible blend of light Colombian and dark Brazilian coffees is here to conquer your taste buds. From the rich nutty aroma to the complex citrus and dark chocolate flavors, this full-bodied blend is sure to deliver whether you're making medium roast drip coffee or espresso.

name: Silencer Smooth Roast
description: For many, Silencer Smooth stands out from the rest and that's largely due to its delightful drinkability. This Latin American Arabica coffee offers a sweet aroma, tasting notes of citrus, caramel, and milk chocolate, and its distinct crisp finish - complementing many of our punchier medium and dark roasts. Essentially, this light roast coffee embodies the ethos of the quiet professional.

name: Beyond Valor Roast
description:
Beyond Valor is a single origin Peru coffee that honors the warriors who answered the call and continues serving those carrying the torch today. This roast supports Beyond the Call, a nonprofit dedicated to preserving veterans' stories and recognizing their sacrifices.
Sourced from the Ayacucho region of Peru and grown at 1800 MASL, this washed Typica and Caturra lot delivers a balanced, medium body with tasting notes of almond, berry, and citrus. Smooth enough for everyday drinking. Bold enough to carry meaning in every cup.
This is more than coffee. It is a reminder that legacy matters and history deserves to be remembered.
Tasting Notes: Almond, Berry, CitrusAroma: AlmondBody: MediumAcidity: MediumOrigin: PeruRegion: AyacuchoProcessing: WashedGrowing Altitude: 1800 MASLRoast: Medium
Honor the past. Serve the present. Drink coffee that stands for something.

name: CAF Roast
description: This revved-up medium roast is a BRCC classic loved by coffee and adrenaline junkies alike. With unruly caffeine content and smoky flavors of maple syrup, milk chocolate, and clove, this Black Rifle Coffee Club staple is sure to power your adrenaline-fueled days.DISCLAIMER: According to the National Institute on Drug Abuse, besides death, a severe caffeine overdose can cause fast and erratic heartbeats, seizures, vomiting, diarrhea, and disorientation.

name: Supply Drop - K-Cup® Variety Pack
description:
Our Mixed Coffee Rounds give you a taste of the entire spectrum of Black Rifle Coffee flavor profiles.
Both 48-count and 96-count K-Cup® boxes contain an even assortment of:

Silencer Smooth Light Roast

Just Black Medium Roast

AK-47 Espresso Blend Medium Roast

Beyond Black  Dark Roast



*These Coffee Rounds come in 48- or 96-count boxes. 
*They are Keurig 2.0 and 1.0 compatible.

name: Maple Pecan
description:
Fall's best kept secret? It's this damn good cup of coffee. Our Maple Pecan flavored roast packs the perfect mix of nutty pecan richness and sweet maple flavor, paired with our classic medium roast profile. It's smooth, satisfying and dangerously easy to drink.
This is the kind of brew that fuels cool weather mornings, porch sits, and second (or third) cups. But like all good things, it won't last. Maple Pecan is limited edition, so grab it now before it's just a memory (and a regret).

name: Hazelnut Coffee Roast
description:
Its time to add a little decadence to your mornings, and the bold aromas and rich toasty flavor of Black Rifle Coffees Hazelnut Coffee will have you feeling fancy as f**k. The earthy and bold flavor profile makes this Coffee Club favorite so good youll forget your creamer.
Disclaimer: This coffee may cause a loss of manliness. Symptoms include: feeling emotions, vibing out to Taylor Swift, excessive use of throw pillows, knitting, increased interest in true crime, and going to the bathroom in groups. If symptoms of man-loss persist, please consult with your doctor.

name: Light Roast Bundle
description:
Not every mission calls for a gut punch. Sometimes you need smooth, easy drinking coffee that still shows up ready to work. The Light Roast Bundle brings together three fan favorite roasts in Ground form: Loyal Spirit, Gunship, and Silencer Smooth. Each bag is roasted light to protect the bean's natural character, so you get brighter, more nuanced flavor in every cup.
 
This bundle is built for coffee drinkers who want variety without sacrificing quality. Rotate through all three, brew them side by side, or stock up so you never run out. Every batch is veteran roasted and quality checked before it ships, because coffee this good doesn't happen by accident.
 
12 oz bags. Ground. Veteran Founded. America's Coffee.

name: Medium Roast Bundle
description:
Meet the best of the middle. This bundle brings together three BRCC favorites—Just Black, AK-Espresso, and Freedom Roast—for a smooth, balanced lineup built for any time of day.
 
From the classic cocoa and vanilla notes of Just Black to the rich, full-bodied flavor of AK-Espresso and the smooth finish of Freedom Roast, this bundle delivers plenty of variety without going too light or too dark.
 
Choose your preferred format:

12 oz Ground
12 oz Whole Bean
12-Count K-Cups® Compatible Pods

 
Includes one of each roast: Just Black, AK-Espresso, and Freedom Roast.

name: Complete Mission Fuel Kit
description:
Not sure what roast you are? Good. Try them all.
 
This bundle covers the full range, from Silencer Smooth's easygoing light roast to the bold one two combo of Just Black and AK Espresso, all the way to Beyond Black's dark roast knockout punch. Four roasts, zero guesswork, one order.
 
Every bag and box is veteran founded, small batch roasted, and built for people who take their coffee as seriously as their mornings. Whether you brew it black, load it into your Keurig, or grind your own beans, this bundle has you covered.
 
What's inside:

Silencer Smooth, Light Roast
Just Black, Medium Roast
AK Espresso, Medium Roast
Beyond Black, Dark Roast

 
Available in 12oz Ground, 12oz Whole Bean, and 12 Count K Cups. Pick your format and start working through the lineup.

name: Freedom Fuel Roast
description:
You've gotta keep that freedom engine running, and only the best coffee will do the job! This roast has a dark and bold flavor, coming in at an 8 on our roast scale of 1-10.
 
This dark roast coffee has tasting notes of dark chocolate, walnut, and anise. Enjoy a flavorful cup of coffee without the bitterness.

name: Thin Blue Line Roast
description:
Thin Blue Line is the ultimate premium coffee with a cause. Thin Blue Line was created solely to benefit law enforcement officers and their families. In addition to enjoying the cocoa and vanilla aromas and smooth buttery finish of this great medium roast, drinking Thin Blue Line allows you to give back to those who serve and protect as law enforcement.

Use our Donation Request Form and one of our donation specialists will help you give back to those who serve our communities every day.

name: Gunship Roast
description: Like its namesake, Gunship has always soared in its role as a light roast that complements our heavy hitters with floral aromas, light caramel tasting notes, and an ultra-smooth finish. Beyond the coffee itself, the roast has become an icon that celebrates our military heritage at BRCC.

name: Coffee or Die Roast
description:
Originally etched in ink by Benjamin Franklin himself, this historic snake woodcut was a call for unity, liberty, and justice. At BRCC, a brand steeped in Americas take-no-shittery, we brought out this amazing roast to show our customers that there are still great companies in America that value freedom and our way of life for all.
With tasting notes of rich milk chocolate, walnuts, and a smooth buttery finish, this medium roast coffee has become a stalwart fan favorite in our lineup.

name: Fit Fuel Blend
description:
Preworkout? Do you mean our Fit Fuel Blend? Let this medium roast fuel your next PR with a delicious combination of bold maple syrup and citrus flavors, and a smooth malt finish.
Unlike a motivational gym quote, this high caffeine medium roast will actually kick start your workout!

name: Dark Chocolate Roast
description:
Step through the gates of flavor and into the realm of decadence‚ Dark Chocolate by Black Rifle Coffee Company isn't just a roast, it's a full-bodied surrender to the dark side of indulgence.
Naturally and artificially flavored, this medium roast brew is laced with rich, velvety dark chocolate, a pop of berry brightness, and a subtle nutty undertone. It's a smooth, seductive ride with just enough bite to remind you that comfort can still come with a side of chaos.
Flavor Profile Highlights:


Deep, smooth dark chocolate foundation


Fruity berry notes that add a tangy lift


Nutty finish for a balanced, rounded cup


Why Dark Chocolate?Through me, you enter the land of endless chocolate‚Ķ This isn‚Äôt your average morning cup. This is for the bold who crave sweetness without weakness. Whether you‚Äôre starting your day or ending it with a splash of something rich, Dark Chocolate delivers a flavor so good, you‚Äôll want to abandon moderation entirely.

name: Fool's Gold Irish Cream
description:
BACK BY POPULAR DEMAND, FOR A LIMITED TIME.Top o' the mornin' to ya! This tactical leprechaun didn't retire, he redeployed. Fool's Gold is back to deliver its legendary Irish Cream inspired flavor in a smooth medium roast that's worth more than the real thing. No rainbow chasing. No fairy tales. Just pure, battle-tested brew.
Fire it up in a batch brewer to unlock the full magic, and if St. Paddy's Day goes the way it should, you might wanna squirrel some away for the next morning. *wink wink* Try to jack his pot of gold, though?
Yeah. He'll f**k you up.

name: Wakin the Neighbors
description:
When that rooster crows first thing in the morning, you better be ready to get up and get after it! Wakin' up the Neighbors is a blend of delicious Arabica with a caffeine boost of Robusta designed to give you the extra energy boost you need. Whether you're rising with the early birds, burning the midnight oil, or heading to the gym to crush your workout, this roast will be your rocket fuel.
*Subscribe & Save: only available for 22-count box.

name: Chocolate-Flavored Coffee
description:
There is nothing like a warm cup of Black Rifle flavored coffee to keep your belly warm. I guess the only way our coffee could taste any better is if we added chocolate to it.
These rounds are based on our classic Just Black Coffee Roast, with a little extra sweetness.

name: Fur Missile
description: Fur Missile roast pays homage to man's best friend; more specifically, the K9 members of our military and law enforcement teams. Fur Missile roast is a delicious Brazilian Arabica, featuring tasting notes of walnut, brown sugar, and guava. These four-legged crimefighters put it all on the line every day, so let's raise a mug of Fur Missile for all our K9 companions out there.

name: Iced Black
description:
When the heat is on, you don't back down‚ you cool off with Iced Black. Built for brew-over-ice missions, this medium roast doesn't mess around. Its strong, smooth, and crafted to go straight over ice without losing firepower.
Iced Black delivers bold, full-bodied flavor that stays crisp even when chilled. With notes of rich chocolate, sweet maple, and a hint of sugar cane, every sip hits like a cold slap of refreshment; sharp, clean, and energizing.
Flavor Profile Highlights:


Deep chocolate base


Smooth maple sweetness


Clean finish with sugar cane clarity


Why Iced Black?No fluff. No froth. Just straight-up iced coffee done the Black Rifle way‚Äîstrong, smooth, and ready to deploy at a moment‚Äôs notice. Whether you‚Äôre cooling down post-mission or gearing up for a hot day, this is iced coffee built for those who run hot and brew cold.

name: Fall Coffee Bundle
description:
The Fall Coffee Bundle brings together two BRCC seasonal favorites: Pumpkin Spice for the unmistakable taste of fall and Bourbon Roast for a rich, smooth brew with a little more backbone. Whether you’re chasing crisp mornings or just ready to retire your summer coffee lineup, these two have you covered.
 
Two bags. Two fall favorites. Zero reason to pick just one.
 
What’s Included:

Bourbon Ground Coffee, 11oz
Pumpkin Spice Ground Coffee, 12oz

name: Montana Knife Company Roast
description:
American brewed, crafted to perfection. This roast is fresh from the forge with tasting notes of chocolate, nuts, and maple.
Master Bladesmith Josh Smith founded Montana Knife Company to create beautifully crafted knives for everyday working Americans. They’re a small crew of hunters and anglers out of Montana who actually use the gear they sell, and they’re living proof the American Dream is still alive and well.
That’s our kind of people. So we teamed up to build a coffee worthy of the name. The Montana Knife Company Collab Roast is a medium roast that opens with rich milk chocolate, settles into earthy nuttiness, and finishes smooth with maple syrup. Balanced, bold, and built for the long haul, whether you’re brewing at camp or at the kitchen counter.
Limited run, so don’t sleep on it.

name: Best Of BRCC
description:
The Best of BRCC Subscription brings you a fresh, exciting coffee experience every month. With a rotating selection of light, medium, dark, and extra dark roasts, you'll enjoy a variety of flavors and profiles, expertly crafted for the perfect brew.
Choose from ground, whole bean, or K-Cups®, and have premium coffee delivered right to your door. By subscribing, you support a Veteran-founded company dedicated to quality and community. Never run out of exceptional coffee again!

name: Caffeinate Mars 2.0, 12oz, Whole Bean
description:
Blast off with Caffeinate Mars, August's Exclusive Coffee Subscription. Sourced from Fraijanes, Guatemala, this co-fermented Caturra delivers bright notes of champagne mango, pineapple, and yuzu citrus with a fruity aroma, velvety body, and effervescent acidity.
Wrapped in collectible retro sci-fi artwork, Caffeinate Mars is a limited edition roast that's built to fuel every mission, from exploring new frontiers to conquering your morning routine.
Current ECS subscribers will receive Caffeinate Mars Roast beginning July 28th. New subscription spots open on August 1st.

name: Royal Elk, 12oz, Whole Bean
description:
You don't stumble into great coffee. You hunt for it.

Royal Elk is our September Exclusive Coffee Subscription release, sourced from El Salvador and roasted in limited quantities for members who appreciate coffee that's a cut above the everyday bag. Bright Meyer lemon curd, sweet Rainier cherry, and wildflower honey come together in a smooth, balanced cup that's built to be brewed, not collected.

Current ECS subscribers will receive Royal Elk Roast beginning August 28th. New subscription spots open on September 1st.

name: Just Medium Canister
description:
Just Medium, Ground Coffee, 16oz Canister
Perfectly balanced and endlessly satisfying, Just Medium is the go-to brew for those who like their coffee just right. Roasted to a smooth medium profile, this ground coffee is crafted with precision to deliver rich, layered flavors of dark chocolate, nutty undertones, and dark cherry. Whether you're brewing your first cup of the day or need a mid-shift boost, this blend has your six.
Veteran-founded and roasted in the USA, this 16oz canister is filled with freshly ground, premium Arabica beans‚engineered to fuel your mission without overpowering your taste buds. It's not too bold, not too light‚ just medium.
 
Best Brewed With:

Pour Over: 2 Tbsp per 6oz water
Traditional Drip: 2 Tbsp per 6oz water

Highlights:

Medium Roast
Ground Coffee
16oz Canister (1 LB / 453g)
Veteran Founded
Roasted in the USA
Proudly supports those who serve

name: Liberty Roast
description:
Four score and seven cups ago, our fore-brewers brought forth a mighty roast, conceived in patriotism, and dedicated to the proposition that not all coffee is created equal.
Liberty Roast is a limited-edition medium roast forged in the fires of freedom and roasted right here in the U-S-of-A. It’s bold enough to wake a bald eagle and smooth enough to be served at the Continental Congress. This isn’t your average cup of bean juice. It’s a red, white, and brewed call to arms for every American who believes liberty should be sipped, not just spoken.
Whether you’re knocking back a K-Cup® in the trenches of your workday or spooning out ground coffee like you’re preparing for a caffeinated revolution, Liberty Roast has your six.
Raise your mug. Defend your morning. And drink like the free.
Get it while it lasts. Because like freedom, once it’s gone, it ain’t coming back easy.

name: Power Llama 3.0
description:
When the sun‚Äôs barely peeking over the horizon and lesser beans are still sleeping in their burlap beds, POWER LLAMA is already locked, loaded, and unleashing a caffeinated crossfire of pure, high-altitude energy. Trained in the legendary Llama Legion, this fearless wool-wrapped warrior carries twin automatic machine guns mounted at his sides‚Äîfiring off bursts of bold flavor and lightning-fast lift to any one brave enough to take a sip.
 
Roast Details:

Origin: Ethiopia
Region: Guji
Growing Altitude: 2000 (M.A.S.L.)
Body:Medium
Acidity: Bright
Varietal: Heirloom
Aroma: Floral
Score: 86.25
Processing Method: Washed

name: Gothic Serpent 3.0, 12oz, Whole Bean
description:
Built to honor a mission. Roasted to be remembered.
Gothic Serpent 3.0 is a limited-run Colombian coffee from the mountains of Huila. This washed Caturra hits with juicy watermelon, bright kaffir lime, and rock candy sweetness for a cup that’s vibrant, balanced, and anything but standard issue.

name: AK Espresso Essentials Bundle
description:
Meet the AK Espresso Essentials Bundle—a full loadout for fans of one of BRCC’s most iconic roasts. This bundle brings together AK Espresso coffee and gear so you can brew it, wear it, and rep the brand.

Whether you're stocking up on AK Espresso or looking for a gift for a fellow coffee lover, this bundle has the essentials covered.

Bundle Includes:

AK-Espresso Roast (Choose from Ground, Whole Bean, or 12ct K-Cups)
AK-47 Espresso T-Shirt
Die-Cut Gun Sheet Sticker Pack, 8.5" x 11"

name: Flavored Coffee Bundle
description:
Can't pick a favorite? Don't. This bundle stacks three of our top flavored roasts, Maple Pecan, Salty Caramel Roast, and Dark Chocolate Roast, so you get variety without the guesswork. name: Exclusive Coffee Subscription
description:
THE RETURN OF FLYING ELK. AT LONG LAST.
Chaos in the canyon. A pyramid with a death ray. UFOs everywhere. A giant golden sentinel ripping its way out of the earth. And just when it looks like the whole thing’s going sideways, Flying Elk tears across the sky to settle the score. Tactisquatch and his jet squadron are bringing the heat from the flank.
It’s been a long wait. Flying Elk is back, and this time he brought something special.
This month’s Founders Club release is a natural processed Tabi from the Tarrazu region of Costa Rica, grown at 1,500 meters. It scored 86.6. It opens with bright citrus on the nose and a medium body. Then the vibrant acidity kicks in, carrying notes of blackberry compote, raw cane sugar, and blood orange. It’s complex and juicy without getting fussy. This is a coffee for people who never settle for average fuel.
Don’t sleep on it. Once Flying Elk lands, he doesn’t stick around.
